newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker supported amid crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker supported amid crude gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes remained firm on Friday amid overnight crude gains and traders expected prices to be well supported in the near term.

As supplies for the 180-cst grade was still tight, the spread between 180-cst/380-cst stayed at a wide $7 per tonne, traders said. "We are making a loss to offer the 180-cst grade," said one trader, noting expensive blending cost.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $105/$106 per tonne and 380-cst at $98/$99. MDO and gas oil stabilised at $198/$200 and $210/$215 respectively.
